```yaml
name: Release Studio

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: '1.26.x'
          cache: true

      - name: Install tooling
        run: make tools

      - name: Format check
        run: make format-check

      - name: Lint
        run: make lint

      - name: Check command docs
        run: make check-command-docs

      - name: Test
        env:
          ASC_BYPASS_KEYCHAIN: 1
        run: make test

  release:
    needs: validate
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    runs-on: macos-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Validate release tag
        run: |
          TAG="${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"

          if [[ ! "$TAG" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::Release tags must match x.y.z. Got: ${TAG}"
            exit 1
          fi

          printf 'VERSION=%s\n' "$TAG" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: '1.26.x'
          cache: true

      - name: Install tooling
        run: make tools

      - name: Self-test docs validators
        run: python3 scripts/test_check_docs.py

      - name: Check release docs updated
        run: make check-release-docs VERSION="${VERSION}"

      - name: Run release guardrails
        run: |
          export PATH="$(go env GOPATH)/bin:$PATH"
          make format-check
          make check-docs
          make check-wall-of-apps
          make lint
          ASC_BYPASS_KEYCHAIN=1 make test

      - name: Create release directory
        run: mkdir -p release

      - name: Import Apple certificate
        uses: apple-actions/import-codesign-certs@v6
        with:
          p12-file-base64: ${{ secrets.APPLE_DEVELOPER_ID_CERT }}
          p12-password: ${{ secrets.APPLE_DEVELOPER_ID_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Build for macOS
        run: |
          COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
          DATE=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
          GOOS=darwin GOARCH=amd64 go build -ldflags "-s -w -X main.version=${VERSION} -X main.commit=${COMMIT} -X main.date=${DATE}" -o release/asc_${VERSION}_macOS_amd64 .
          GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 go build -ldflags "-s -w -X main.version=${VERSION} -X main.commit=${COMMIT} -X main.date=${DATE}" -o release/asc_${VERSION}_macOS_arm64 .

      - name: Code sign macOS binaries
        if: env.APPLE_DEVELOPER_ID != ''
        run: |
          for binary in release/asc_*_macOS_*; do
            codesign --force --sign "${{ secrets.APPLE_DEVELOPER_ID }}" --timestamp --options=runtime "$binary"
          done
        env:
          APPLE_DEVELOPER_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_DEVELOPER_ID }}

      - name: Build for Linux
        run: |
          COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
          DATE=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
          GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -ldflags "-s -w -X main.version=${VERSION} -X main.commit=${COMMIT} -X main.date=${DATE}" -o release/asc_${VERSION}_linux_amd64 .
          GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go build -ldflags "-s -w -X main.version=${VERSION} -X main.commit=${COMMIT} -X main.date=${DATE}" -o release/asc_${VERSION}_linux_arm64 .

      - name: Build for Windows
        run: |
          COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
          DATE=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
          GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -ldflags "-s -w -X main.version=${VERSION} -X main.commit=${COMMIT} -X main.date=${DATE}" -o release/asc_${VERSION}_windows_amd64.exe .

      - name: Create checksums
        run: |
          cd release
          shasum -a 256 asc_${VERSION}_* > asc_${VERSION}_checksums.txt

      - name: Create release archive
        uses: thdeo/zip-release@0.7.6
        with:
          filename: asc_${VERSION}_all_platforms.zip
          path: release/asc_${VERSION}_*

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: release/asc_${VERSION}_all_platforms.zip
          asset_name: asc_${VERSION}_all_platforms.zip
          tag: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          release_name: Release ${{ github.ref_name }}
          body: |
            ## Release Notes
            
            See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/rudrankriyam/App-Store-Connect-CLI/blob/main/resources/changelog.md) for details.
            
            ### Assets
            - macOS (Intel): asc_${VERSION}_macOS_amd64
            - macOS (Apple Silicon): asc_${VERSION}_macOS_arm64
            - Linux (x86_64): asc_${VERSION}_linux_amd64
            - Linux (ARM64): asc_${VERSION}_linux_arm64
            - Windows (x86_64): asc_${VERSION}_windows_amd64.exe
            - Checksums: asc_${VERSION}_checksums.txt

      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: rm -rf release/
```
